column1: # M3 baseline. Isolated pipelines = fixed prelude 'sroa' then exactly one pass (opt -passes=sroa
column2: <pass>); 'sroa' row = prelude alone; O2/O3 = opt -passes=default<O2|O3> on the same seed IR. Seed IR: clang $CLANG_IRFLAGS. Plain builds: every module codegen'd with clang -O0
column3: no sanitizers. UB attribution: separate -O0 ASan+UBSan source build. Alive2: alive-tv seed.ll <pipeline>.ll
column5: unroll=alive2_unroll for loop seeds. weakened = guard id still in IR but an input that printed GUARD at O0 no longer does.
